title: Punjab Local Government Tenth Amendment Ordinance 2002

sections.shortTitle: Punjab Local Government Tenth Amendment Ordinance 2002
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE LXVI OF 2002
PUNJAB LOCAL
GOVERNMENT (TENTH AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE LXVI OF 2002
An Ordinance
further to amend the Punjab Local Government Ordinance, 2001.
[Gazette of Punjab,
Extraordinary, 8th October, 2002]
No. Legis.13-59/2000/VI, dated
8-10-2002.--The following Ordinance promulgated by the Governor of the
Punjab is hereby published for general information:
1. Short title and
commencement.---(1) This Ordinance may be called the Punjab Local
Government (Tenth Amendment) Ordinance, 2002.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.description:
Amendment in section 156 of Ordinance XIII of 2001

ORDINANCE LXVI OF 2002
PUNJAB
LOCAL GOVERNMENT (TENTH AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE LXVI OF 2002
An Ordinance
further to amend the Punjab Local Government
Ordinance, 2001.
[Gazette of Punjab,
Extraordinary, 8th October, 2002]
No. Legis.13-59/2000/VI, dated
8-10-2002.--The following Ordinance promulgated by the Governor of the
Punjab is hereby published for general information:
2. Amendment in section 156 of
Ordinance XIII of 2001.--In the said Ordinance, in section 156--
(i) in subsection (4) the word
".sixty." shall be substituted by words and commas", as far as
practicable, one hundred and twenty": and
(ii) in subsection (5), the word
"thirty" shall be substituted by the words and commas ", as far
as practicable, one hundred and twenty".
